scripts.db:apply: for m in ../database/schema/*/; do for f in tables functions triggers rls grants; do [ ! -f "$m$f.sql" ] || psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f "$m$f.sql" || exit 1; done; done
scripts.db:seed: for f in ../database/seed/reference/*.sql; do psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:test: rc=0; for f in ../database/tests/*.test.sql; do echo "== $f"; out=$(psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -At -f "$f" 2>&1) || rc=1; echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -qE '^not ok|# Looks like' && rc=1; done; exit $rc
scripts.codegen: mkdir -p contracts && supabase gen types --lang typescript --local --schema public,api > contracts/database.types.ts && psql "$DB_URL" -X -At -c "select '// Generated by backend codegen from public.error_codes. Do not edit.' || chr(10) || 'export const ERROR_CODES = {' || chr(10) || string_agg(format('  %s: { httpStatus: %s, description: %s },', code, http_status, to_json(description)), chr(10) order by code) || chr(10) || '} as const;' || chr(10) || chr(10) || 'export type ErrorCode = keyof typeof ERROR_CODES;' from public.error_codes" > contracts/errors.ts
